arxiv-2108-07638.title: A Weakly Supervised Dataset of Fine-Grained Emotions in Portuguese
arxiv-2108-07638.creator: Diogo Cortiz 1,2, Jefferson O. Silva 2,4, Newton Calegari 2, Ana Luísa Freitas 3
arxiv-2108-07638.description: Abstract Affective Computing is the study of how computers can recognize, interpret and simulate human affects. Sentiment Analysis is a common task in NLP related to this topic, but it focuses only on emotion valence (positive, negative, neutral). An emerging approach in NLP is Emotion Recognition, which relies on fined-grained classification.

arxiv-2111-00628.title: Inverse K K -Chevalley formulas for semi-infinite flag manifolds, II: arbitrary weights in ADE type
arxiv-2111-00628.creator: Cristian Lenart, Satoshi Naito, Daniel Orr, Daisuke Sagaki
arxiv-2111-00628.description: Abstract . We continue the study, begun in [ KoNOS ] , of inverse Chevalley formulas for the equivariant K K -group of semi-infinite flag manifolds. Using the language of alcove paths, we reformulate and extend our combinatorial inverse Chevalley formula to arbitrary weights in all simply-laced types (conjecturally also for E 8 E_{8} ). 1. Introduction.

arxiv-2202-11643.title: A posteriori error estimates for Darcy-Forchheimer’s problem Thanks: August 8, 2026. † Laboratoire de "Mathématiques et Applications", Unité de Recherche "Mathématoqies et Modélisation", CAR, Faculté des sciences de Beyrouth, Université Saint-Joseph de Beyrouth, Liban. Emails :toni.sayah@usj.edu.lb,
arxiv-2202-11643.creator: Toni Sayah †, Georges Semaan †, Faouzi Triki ‡
arxiv-2202-11643.description: Abstract . This work deals with the a posteriori error estimates for the Darcy-Forchheimer problem. We introduce the corresponding variational formulation and discretize it by using the finite-element method. A posteriori error estimate with two types of computable error indicators is showed. The first one is linked to the linearization and the second one to the discretization.

arxiv-2510-12895.title: Mean Motion Resonances in AGN Disks
arxiv-2510-12895.creator: Marguerite Epstein-Martin, Nicholas Stone, Juliette Becker
arxiv-2510-12895.description: Abstract Mean motion resonances (MMRs) are a generic outcome of convergent migration for bodies embedded in accretion disks around a central mass. Long studied in planetary systems, the same phenomenon should occur for stellar-mass black holes (BHs) in AGN disks.

arxiv-2511-19020.title: Detection of Number of Subcarriers of OFDM Systems using Eigen-Spectral Analysis
arxiv-2511-19020.creator: Vishnu Priya Chekuru, Ganapathiraju S S Ananya Varma, Arti Yardi, Praful Mankar
arxiv-2511-19020.description: Abstract Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is widely used in modern wireless communication systems due to its robustness against time-dispersive channels. In this work, we consider a non-cooperative scenario where the receiver does not have prior knowledge of the OFDM parameters such as the number of subcarriers and the aim is to estimate them using the received data.

britannica-1911-squill.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-squill.description: Article 'Squill' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Scilla is used in medicine. It belongs to the natural order Liliaceae. The name of “squill” is also applied by gardeners to the various species of Scilla. The medicinal squill is a native of the countries bordering the Mediterranean, and grows from the sea-level up to an elevation of 3000 ft. The bulbs are globular and of large size, often weighing more than 4 ℔.

Data from the genetic characterization of Fasciola population shed light on the spread of infections among animals which could help in the development of effective parasite control.

pmc-11716440.title: Associations between New Deal emergency employment of teachers and teachers per student with late‐life cognition among Health and Retirement Study Participants
pmc-11716440.creator: Chloe W Eng, David Rehkopf, Sepideh Modrek
pmc-11716440.description: BackgroundHigher school quality, and decreased student‐teacher ratio in particular, is associated with improvements in late‐life cognition. New deal emergency employment programs in the 1930s provided funding for hundreds of thousands of teachers in response to sweeping school budget cuts of the Great Depression.

pmc-12472620.title: Obeticholic Acid and Other Farnesoid-X-Receptor (FXR) Agonists in the Treatment of Liver Disorders
pmc-12472620.creator: Stefano Fiorucci, Ginevra Urbani, Eleonora Distrutti, Michele Biagioli
pmc-12472620.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The Farnesoid-X-receptor (FXR) is a bile sensor involved in the regulation of bile acid homeostasis, fibrosis, inflammation, and metabolism. Obeticholic acid (OCA), a semisynthetic derivative of chenodeoxycholic acid (CDCA), initially named 6-ethyl-CDCA or INT-747, is the first in a class of FXR ligands that have been approved for clinical use for the treatment of patients with primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) who are unresponsive or intolerant to ursodeoxycholic acid.

pmc-12488463.title: Anthropogenic noise exposure suppresses the immune response in Mytilus spp. following Vibrio splendidus challenge
pmc-12488463.creator: Ambre F. Chapuis, Matthew A. Wale, Morgan Bailey, Hannah M. Farley, Tim P. Bean, Tim Regan
pmc-12488463.description: IntroductionAnthropogenic noise is a growing environmental stressor in marine ecosystems, yet its effects on immune function in bivalves remain poorly understood.MethodsThis study examined the transcriptional response of blue mussels, Mytilus spp., following exposure to ship noise for seven days, followed by a low-dose Vibrio splendidus bath challenge.

pmc-12705087.title: Multimodality Imaging of a Ruptured Ovarian Dermoid Cyst Presenting As Disseminated Granulomatous Inflammation: A Radiology Case Report
pmc-12705087.creator: Gearry Mohanraj, Dilrukshi Gunatillake
pmc-12705087.description: Dermoid cysts develop when epithelium and tissue are enveloped in a sac. A rupture of an ovarian dermoid (mature cystic teratoma) is uncommon and can rarely mimic disseminated malignancy on radiological imaging. This case describes an adult woman developing progressive abdominopelvic fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG)-avid lesions following laparoscopic dermoid cystectomy.

pmc-13070326.title: Cranial anatomy, palaeoneurology, palaeobiology and stratigraphic age of the large-bodied ornithopod, Muttaburrasaurus langdoni Bartholomai and Molnar, 1981, from the mid-Cretaceous of Australia
pmc-13070326.creator: Matthew C. Herne, Joseph J. Bevitt, Luke Milan, Scott A. Hocknull, Alan M. Tait, Charlotte M. Allen, Andrew C. Rozefelds, Ralph E. Molnar, Vera Weisbecker, Phil R. Bell
pmc-13070326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The holotype of Muttaburrasaurus langdoni Bartholomai & Molnar, 1981, a large-bodied ornithopod from the mid-Cretaceous of Australia, consists of an almost complete skull and partial postcranium, and is among the most skeletally complete ornithopods from Gondwana. The taxon was defined by a dorsally inflated muzzle, thought to be formed by the nasals, enlarged mandibular adductor musculature and cheek teeth thought to have a uniquely en masse eruption pattern. The rostrum, however, was unknown.

pmc-13226587.title: Systematic review of artificial intelligence use in behavioral analysis of invertebrate and larval model organisms: methods, applications and future recommendations
pmc-13226587.creator: Zuzanna Stępnicka, Natalia Piórkowska, Malwina Brożyna, Tomasz Matys, Adam Junka
pmc-13226587.description: Invertebrate and larval model organisms such as Drosophila melanogaster, Caenorhabditis elegans, Danio rerio larvae, and Galleria mellonella are increasingly employed in biomedical, toxicological, and ecological research. Their behavioral responses serve as sensitive indicators of functional changes, yet traditional methods of observation remain low-throughput, subjective, and poorly scalable.

pmc-13227531.title: Sunvozertinib in EGFR Exon 20 Insertion NSCLC: Approved but Not Available – Practical Dose Selection Considerations and Real-World Access Challenges
pmc-13227531.creator: Kim Abbegail Tan Aldecoa, Zhaohui Liao Arter, Sai-Hong Ignatius Ou, Misako Nagasaka
pmc-13227531.description: Sunvozertinib has emerged as one of the most promising tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) for previously treated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 20 insertion (exon20ins) mutations, a molecular subset with limited sensitivity to conventional EGFR TKIs and a persistent unmet need especially in the second-line setting.

pmc-13241650.title: Primary ureteral extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma mimicking urothelial carcinoma: A case report
pmc-13241650.creator: Guilherme Bernardo, João A. Carvalho, Maria Alzamora, Rui Henrique, António Morais
pmc-13241650.description: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) involving the ureter is particularly uncommon, and histological transformation to diffuse large B- cell lymphoma (DLBCL) further complicates diagnosis and management. We report a case of a female patient presenting with obstructive uropathy caused by long-segment ureteral wall thickening radiologically suggestive of urothelial carcinoma.

pmc-13428914.title: The Role of the Fear of Positive Evaluation in the Relationship Between Social Anxiety and the Pride Experience and Expression
pmc-13428914.creator: Gorana Birovljević, Petra Anić, Asmir Gračanin
pmc-13428914.description: There is a significant gap in research concerning the relationship between social anxiety and the expression of pride. This study examines the mediating role of fear of positive evaluation in the relationship between social anxiety and both the tendency to express pride and the momentary experience of authentic and hubristic pride.

pmc-13473954.title: Hydrogel co-delivery of 5-fluorouracil and siRNA attenuates TGF-β1-mediated MMT to prevent postoperative peritoneal metastasis and adhesion in colorectal cancer
pmc-13473954.creator: Jinpeng Wen, Jiangchuan He, Yunhe Zheng, Ting Wang, Kailai Liu, Hanchao Zhou, Yuchen Zhang, Yu Huang, Chen Zhang, Yue Zhang, Ke Wang
pmc-13473954.description: Cytoreductive surgery is the treatment protocol for colorectal cancer. Nonetheless, a major medical challenge remains to fully eliminate malignant tumor cells, along with a number of complications such as peritoneal adhesion and tumor peritoneal metastasis. The occurrence of peritoneal adhesions compromises not only the ability to do subsequent surgery, but also the efficacy of adjunct chemotherapy.

pmc-13561103.title: Artificial Intelligence Is a Useful Tool in Exercise Science and Sports Medicine
pmc-13561103.creator: BRADLEY C. NINDL, KARL E. FRIEDL
pmc-13561103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). icine, rather than a replacement for expert judgment. AI has become sufficiently influential that Professor Karim Lakhani at Harvard Business School has asserted that “AI won’t replace humans—but humans with AI will replace humans without AI” (1). Not replacing human thinking but enhancing human performance, AI can rapidly perform a large number of computations in the analyses of massive amounts of information, with important applications such as the identification of complex patterns that exceed unaided human capabilities (2).

pmc-13630760.title: Dictogloss-based instruction and conjunction use in Palestinian tenth-grade EFL learners
pmc-13630760.creator: Ahmad Jamil Abukhiran, Guliz Ozuturk
pmc-13630760.description: IntroductionThe study aimed to examine differences in tenth-grade students' performance in the use of conjunctions between Dictogloss-based instruction and traditional instruction after controlling for pre-test performance, to examine the association of Matching familiar figures test (MFFT) response latency and error rate with post-test performance, and to explore their moderating role in the relationship between instructional method and post-test performance.
